function: Channel estimation for wideband THz UM-MIMO: generative-network deep compressed sensing (DCS) recovers the channel from Np pilots via latent optimization with a few gradient steps (pp. 3, 6-8).
system: Multi-carrier THz UM-MIMO, 256 Tx and 32 Rx antennas (array-of-subarrays, hybrid beamforming), 300 GHz, 10 GHz bandwidth, 8 subcarriers, near field at 1 m; no RIS (pp. 4, 9).
method: DCGAN generator with latent-space gradient descent; offline training on ground-truth channels with NMSE plus RIP loss in a dual loop, meta-learning principle, no discriminator (pp. 3, 7-8).
data_channel: TeraMIMO statistical THz simulator built on measurement data, modified (AE-level spherical wave, receiver rotation, HITRAN absorption); 5000 training and 1000 test channels (p. 9, Table 2).
test_conditions: Trained on 5000 channels (LoS+NLoS, spacing lambda/2, rotation pi/6, 100 pilots); tested on 1000 channels and out-of-distribution pilots 10-200, LoS-only, spacing lambda/5, lambda/10, rotation 2pi/9 (pp. 9, 14).
baselines: Classical: LS, LMMSE, OMP; learned: pre-trained GAN estimator [23], [24] with the same generator, 10 restarts of 50 steps (pp. 12-13).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR (-20 to 15 dB), pilot length, latent dimension and optimization steps; training convergence in epochs; inference steps (pp. 10-14).
complexity: Table 6: DCS O(TNsNpNtNr), GAN O(RT'NsNpNtNr), LS and LMMSE O(Nt^3Nr^3), OMP O(SNtNr); 20 steps versus GAN's 500 (pp. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 9: "channel simulator built on the measurement data in [55], [56]"; the authors adopt TeraMIMO, a published statistical THz simulator (ref. [8]) built on measurements, with their own near-field and rotation changes. It is not a 3GPP model, so see notes.
q2_support: p. 14: "we train our model with Np = 100 pilots but test it across" Np from 10 to 200; Table 7 also tests LoS-only channels, other antenna spacings and a larger rotation angle than in training.
q3_support: p. 12: "benchmarks: standard LS, LMMSE with estimated" second-order statistics, OMP, and a pre-trained GAN estimator ([23], [24] in Table 6); all are compared on NMSE in Fig. 8 and Table 5.
q4_support: p. 12: "We summarize the computation complexity of the aforementioned CE algorithms in Table 6"; page 13 gives DCS O(T Ns Np Nt Nr) against GAN O(R T' Ns Np Nt Nr), LS and LMMSE O(Nt^3 Nr^3), OMP O(S Nt Nr).
q5_support: p. 1: "Data is available on-line at https://github.com/ganghui0/dcs-thz-mimo-ce"; the repository link is stated on the first page. I did not open the link.
notes: Included, area 2: DCS is a learned generative channel estimator for THz UM-MIMO. q1 is a proposal for the reviewer to confirm: the data come from TeraMIMO [8], a published statistical THz simulator built on measurement data [55], [56], modified by the authors (AE-level spherical wave, receiver rotation, HITRAN absorption, Poisson clusters and rays); it is neither a listed 3GPP model nor DeepMIMO (page 9). q3: the GAN baseline uses the same DCGAN generator as DCS but is an earlier published estimator [23], [24], so I counted it as a learned baseline and not as a variant of the proposed method.
